title: Mixed Event — Wishing to the Blue Sky for Your Happiness! — Episode8 From Now On, Be Myself!

meta.Event: Wishing to the Blue Sky for Your Happiness!
meta.Episode: Episode8 — From Now On, Be Myself!
meta.Event Outline: A photographer who is a regular at the cafe asks An if she would be her bridal model. An, who cares deeply about those around her, pushes past her embarrassment and accepts. At the wedding venue, An encounters another bridal model—Shizuku.

rows.Line: The next day
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And so, our shoot ended up going pretty well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Man...
You guys really went through a lot...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm still wondering why Vivi the cat was there at all...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right around when Vivi disappeared, I saw all these trucks making stops at this new shop that was getting ready to open.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: My guess is that Vivi hopped onto one of those trucks by accident.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If that's true, she must've gotten lost after jumping off of the truck she was on.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see... That's certainly plausible.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, what's she up to now?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She followed us back when we left. I think she really missed Vivid Street, and she's back chilling in her usual spot!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay...
That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
And it sounds like you guys took some good pictures.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's right!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The photos we saw right at the end were so good too. It's so incredible what professional photographers are capable of...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And I was so relieved to hear that Ms. Kinuya managed to get some cleaners to wash the dress I almost ruined.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, here we are....!
Hello!
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, hello there!
How'd the shoot go, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It went great!
I'm also here because I really need to thank you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That's wonderful.
Thank you for stopping by!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, Kohane told me about how us singing together was originally your suggestion.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thank you so much for that!
After that, I was able to just be myself for the shoot!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. It was nothing, really.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: All I said to Kohane was to think about the An she's come to know and when that girl shines the most.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, to think that singing was the answer... I wish I could've been there to hear you sing, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I can't help but blush a little when you say something like that, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, um... That reminded me of something An said is all...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Something she said?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, it was right around the time when An and I had just met. We talked a little about MEIKO together...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An mentioned how she wanted MEIKO to tell her, “Hey, sunshine, it's already morning. Wakey-wakey,” or, “Eat right and give it all you got again today.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And this time...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: When you were with Shizuku, you seemed so happy and cuter than usual.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think it's because you sort of want to be coddled or waited on by someone older than you, like a big sister...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane, wait...!
You didn't have to say it aloud...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?! Was I supposed to keep that to myself...?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's so sweet of you.
I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see... I didn't realize that's what you really wanted, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Because it's not!
Okay, maybe I kinda do, but it's not a deep desire or anything like that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes, I think MEIKO and Shizuku are wonderful ladies who you can always rely on. It's not that I want to be coddled by them, but I want to be...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hm?
What's the matter, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's it...
I subconsciously wanted to be just that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Someone reliable with a good head on their shoulders... That's what I always looked up to and tried to force myself into becoming a “lady”.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And it's probably because...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Aunt Nagi was always there.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sorry, my bad!
It's nothing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, you guys all made me realize that what I was doing didn't suit the current me at all!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, I was reminded of who I want to become...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Who you want to become?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I want to become someone you can all be proud of. That includes you, Kohane, as well as Akito, Toya, MEIKO, the others... And everyone around town!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So I'm gonna keep taking on and overcoming the challenges that are thrown at me!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And someday...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Someday, I'm gonna surpass that!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (An really is an amazingly cool girl...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It doesn't matter if something doesn't go well for her. She always just gets back up and believes she'll overcome whatever hurdle's in front of her...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Hehe. I honestly couldn't be happier to have such a cool and adorable girl as my partner!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Good, that's what we wanna hear from you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I agree.
It's very you, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, An, how does something special off the menu sound as a reward for all your hard work?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Here you are!
I call it An's Special Platter.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
Hold on. Is this rum raisin ice cream on top of this chocolate cake?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
I tried putting all of your favorite things onto one plate.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It looks delicious...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Would you like some of that as well, Akito...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude, you really think I want all of that?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I also have some mini versions for everyone else. I even made yours extra bitter, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seriously?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, you guys, once we're done refueling, let's get back to practicing!
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wow! That was so good!
I feel like I can sing all day long now!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's good to hear that you're in such high spirits. So, let's start practicing...
se_event_happiness_2022_006

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? This cat just walked right up towards us...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hi, Vivi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It's looking up at us...
Is it asking for something to eat?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Wait, maybe she wants us to sing for her?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I told Kohane this the other day, but Vivi here apparently understands music and stops to listen to anyone she thinks is good!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What is that? Some kind of superstition?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've heard that certain species of animals are able to comprehend music, so cats may very well fall into that category...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
We don't actually know if it's true...
But how about we try singing for her?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, why not? We were gonna sing regardless.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. It might be fun to sing with a cat as our audience too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh dear... This doesn't seem like the right place either...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I can't seem to find my way even after calling Airi. What should I do...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There you are... Why'd you wander off course during our run?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry...
I just happened to see this lovely-looking street...
song00005_off_f

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huh?
I think I hear...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Are people singing at the park?
They're awfully good too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, isn't that An and her team...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It is! I see Akito and everyone else!
They must be practicing here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They all have these serious expressions on their faces too... They must be working very hard towards surpassing that really incredible event.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh... Hehe. Our little friend that An saved is there too. See?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I see her.
She's sitting so still... Almost as if she's listening to them very intently.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I can understand why too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but we're not letting them hog all the glory!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, Airi, let's keep going...!
I feel like I can run for an entire day now!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Same!
Wait, you're going in the opposite direction...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whew...!
Hey, that felt really good?! What do you guys think?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. We had a very good rhythm going there just now. Let's keep that in mind and have another go.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's put the pedal to the metal today.

rows.Speaker: Vivi
rows.Line: Meow!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Vivi just...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Sounds like she wants an encore!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, we're gonna keep singing until Vivi feels satisfied!!
